purpose: Test whether reduced FiLM capacity supplies the minimum non-physics identifiability constraint without imposing a fixed tail form.

initialization.target: read-only accepted FNP for the selected dataset candidate
initialization.metric: weighted mean squared log-FNP difference on 64 dense log-x nodes plus diagnostic knots, with b weight 1/(1+(b/2)^4), preventing sparse-x interpolation and the unconstrained extreme tail from overwhelming the data-sensitive region
initialization.interpretation: Function distillation is followed by selected-source prediction distillation in the experimental-sigma metric. Both are initialization aids only; the subsequent objective contains no anchor to the accepted FNP or predictions.

conditional_extension_rule: If no initial two-block architecture passes fit quality, run w32_c24_b3 and w40_c28_b3 to isolate depth from width, and w48_c32_b2 to isolate depth at production width. Do not run the extension if an initial architecture already passes all central gates.
pilot_rule: Find the smallest capacity preserving the frozen unpenalized fit-quality gate; then apply independent starts and, if needed, the weakest viable soft smoothness prior.
